description: NHANES participant identifier; not a predictor.
Target: sum of the nine PHQ-9 symptom items, valid range 0-27.
Age in years; NHANES top-codes ages 80 and above as 80.
Sex: 1 = male, 2 = female.

Education among adults aged 20+: 1 = less than 9th grade; 2 = 9-11th grade or 12th grade without diploma; 3 = high school/GED; 4 = some college/associate degree; 5 = college graduate or above. Special codes set missing.
Marital status: 1 = married/living with partner; 2 = widowed/divorced/separated; 3 = never married. Special codes set missing.
Family income-to-poverty ratio; 5.00 represents 5.00 or more.
Household size; 7 represents 7 or more people.
Weighted average sleep: (5 * weekday hours + 2 * weekend hours) / 7; computed only when both values are in the documented 2-14 range.
Ever smoked at least 100 cigarettes: 1 = yes, 0 = no; special/invalid values set missing.
Current smoking frequency among respondents routed to this question: 1 = every day, 2 = some days, 3 = not at all; special/invalid values set missing.
Estimated annual number of drinking occasions derived from NHANES past-year frequency categories. Approximate, not an exact count.
Average drinks per drinking day: source values 1-14 retained; 15 represents 15 or more; set to zero when ALQ121 indicates never drinking; missing when drinking frequency is invalid.
Estimated annual number of heavy drinking occasions, derived from NHANES frequency categories. Approximate, not an exact count.
Estimated minutes per week of moderate-intensity leisure-time physical activity.
Estimated minutes per week of vigorous-intensity leisure-time physical activity.
Minutes spent sitting on a typical day, from PAD680.
Adult food security category: 1 = full; 2 = marginal; 3 = low; 4 = very low food security.
Family has more than $5,000 in savings/cash assets: 1 = yes, 0 = no; special/invalid values set missing.
Alternative categorical version of moderate weekly activity: low, medium, high based on approximate thirds of valid values.
Alternative categorical version of vigorous weekly activity: low, medium, high based on approximate thirds of valid values.
